Sure! Here's a positive review for the Weber Q 1200 Gas Grill:

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Perfect Portable Grill for Flavor and Convenience!

I’ve been using the Weber Q 1200 for a few months now, and I couldn’t be happier with my purchase. This compact grill is a powerhouse in a small package. Right out of the box, it’s clear that Weber put a lot of thought into the design — it’s sleek, sturdy, and incredibly easy to use.

Results.ReviewText: I had my Weber Q for a number of years. I converted it (by removing the regulator and adding quick connects) to use my RV Propane connector instead of having to carry a separate propane tank (weight and safety). Everything was fine until the gas valve corroded and tried to replace it.  It is not available as a standalone part.  You have to buy the the value and regulator together (and they can not be separated). So now I either have to convert back to a separate propane tank OR just throw the whole thing away. I paid extra for the Weber name because I thought it would be the last grill I had to buy and could get replacement parts without worrying about the company not.  How wrong I was!!!!!!
Results.Title: DO NOT BUY for RVing

Results.ReviewText: Great size, great quality, easy to start. Had owned a Weber Q grill previously, but replaced it with a lesser brand (don’t ask!), and that grill gave out early in its lifespan. I went back to Weber, to find the Q1200 to be just as good, if not better, than I remember!
Results.Title: Back to Q1200, why’d I ever leave?!?!

Results.ReviewText: Wonderful grill especially for individuals or small families. Love being able to remove and clean the grill pieces indoors. Also you can take it with you on camping trips and other outdoor events.
Results.Title: A little grill with lots of options

Results.ReviewText: I previously had a large Weber grill for a good 30+ years!  The length of time is review enough for the tremendous quality Weber maintains!  Now, with a smaller amount of people around I needed a smaller one.  This grill is adorable. it was so easy to put together and clean. It’s a charm and I am once again grilling good steaks, corn, zucchinis and peppers as if it was a big grill.  It is not too small nor too big for my needs.  If you want quality you will never go wrong with Weber.  I am a fan of quality!!!!
Results.Title: Perfect!

Results.ReviewText: For a family or party of up to four people, this is the perfect grill. It's well-designed, portable, starts up immediately and provides excellent temperature control. In addition, the heat from the flames is evenly distributed, especially with the enamel coated two-part grill. These are readily cleaned with a stainless steel pad and a run through the dishwasher. The ease of cleaning the inside of the grill is appreciated, along with the replacement catch tray for fat, oil, etc. I feel that for the price, this well made grill is just about perfect.
Results.Title: Great Small, Portable Grill

Results.ReviewText: I recently bought a Weber Q1200 and loved it. However the regulator stopped working so quickly compared to any of my other precious grills where it was never a proble. Getting a replacement part has been like pulling teeth. They put an order in and when you check fedex tracking it just doesn't move. I emailed them multiple times to ask them to look into it and they just said to wait. Then after 2 weeks I emailed them again and they said they put in another order and now I have to wait another 2 weeks and the fedex tracking still says the same thing it did last time: "Your order hasn't been picked up yet". Really disappointing.
Results.Title: Horrible service
